scope: Read-only post-candidate runtime observation during untouched original-v3 control; not historical or prelaunch provenance.

native_score_interpretation.score_trigger: All grippers open, rising edge. Sleeve checks are the first tier; sleeve and hem/alignment checks are the second.
native_score_interpretation.success_gate: RewardManager._score_for_state demotes a completed100 tier to20 if final reward success is false. A reported20 alone does not identify which final physical condition failed.
native_score_interpretation.return_home: fold_clothes.get_reward registers a success check when grippers open and both arms at origin, and per-arm origin rising-edge failure queries. Early native termination while going home does not establish a defect in the home controller.
native_score_interpretation.diagnosis_limit: Per-condition native truth/counters were not recorded in these policy trajectories. Do not infer a specific failed rule from model final prose or score20 alone.

limitations: Historical CLI executable bytes and service snapshot are unavailable.
Git status and commit dates observed now do not prove the exact runtime state during historical episodes.
